mapper.select: SELECT * FROM spare_part WHERE available_qty <= min_stock AND min_stock > 0
SELECT * FROM spare_part ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO spare_part (part_code, part_name, equipment_type, total_qty, available_qty, reserved_qty, min_stock, unit_price, version) VALUES (#{partCode}, #{partName}, #{equipmentType}, #{totalQty}, #{availableQty}, #{reservedQty}, #{minStock}, #{unitPrice}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE spare_part SET available_qty = available_qty - #{qty}, reserved_qty = reserved_qty + #{qty}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND available_qty >= #{qty}
UPDATE spare_part SET available_qty = available_qty + #{qty}, reserved_qty = reserved_qty - #{qty}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE spare_part SET total_qty = total_qty - #{qty}, reserved_qty = reserved_qty - #{qty}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
